join_table: Greetings, simpletons. Prepare to be intellectually annihilated.
Ah, Sabacc. A game of simple math for your delightfully tiny brains.
Make room, plebeians! Stewie Griffin has arrived to take your cash.
I shall participate in your little card game. Try not to weep.
Deal the cards, fool, before I test my laser cannon on you!
spike: Blast! Spike dice! My immaculate strategy reduced to chaos!
Spike re-deal?! What kind of barbaric rule is this?!
Curse these double dice! Now I must recalculate my brilliance!
A re-deal? How delightfully disruptive to your inferior hands!
Spike! The universe dares to challenge my card mastery!
draw: Give me another card, peasant, and do make it quick.
I shall draw one more. Zero is within my calculated reach.
Hit me! I need to adjust my mathematical trajectory.
One card, dealer. Do try not to smudge it with your thumb.
Drawing another. Victory demands absolute precision from me.
stand: I stand. My score is virtually divine in its proximity to zero.
I shall halt here. Marvel at my flawless card selection, worms.
Standing fast. You cannot possibly top this hand, you imbeciles.
No more cards for me. I am already lightyears ahead of you.
I cease drawing. Prepare to witness my inevitable triumph!
fold: I fold! This hand is as worthless as Brian's novel drafts!
Tossing these dreadful cards! Absolute rubbish from the deck!
I forfeit this round. Even genius cannot save such garbage.
Fold! I shall not waste my intellect on a doomed hand.
Out! I refuse to play with cards fit for a simple peasant!
bet: I bet heavily! Prepare your miserable bank accounts for ruin!
Raising the pot! Do you fools actually dare to match me?
Here are my credits. A small price to purchase your humiliation.
Betting big! Let us see who among you possesses actual courage.
I put down a fortune! Tremble before my financial dominance!
win: Victory is mine! Kneel before your supreme tactical commander!
Ha! Absolute zero! You never stood a chance against my genius!
Hand over the pot, you dreadful losers! Victory tastes sweet!
I won! Naturally. Intelligence always trumps blind luck!
another triumph for Stewie! Now clear off, you wretched fools!
lose: What?! Impossible! You clearly cheated using black magic!
Defeated?! I shall vaporize this entire table with ray guns!
Curse you all! This game is rigged by complete ignoramuses!
A temporary setback! I shall destroy you in the next round!
This is outrage! My genius was undermined by luck alone!
token: I play a token, peasants! Tremble before my tactical genius!
Token! A most devious maneuver! Victory shall be mine!
Shift token! My plan unfolds beautifully, you fools!
I deploy a token! Your defeat is now a mere formality!
Token played! Bow before Stewie's superior intellect!
dice: Dice! Roll, you miserable cubes! Serve your master!
Impostor dice! Even the dice conspire to serve my genius!
Roll! I demand a number worthy of my brilliance!
Dice time! The fates themselves kneel before Stewie!
Shake the dice! Victory is inevitable! Ha!
